description: Use this after the user has chosen one of the concepts from start_motion. Starts the build of that concept (uses 5 credits from the user's balance; failed or stopped builds give them back). The builder writes the animation, renders it, checks its quality and packages code for each platform. Takes 5 to 30 minutes; check with get_motion. Requires a linked Charmotion account.

adjust.description: Optional small change to the chosen concept, in the user's words.

concept_id.description: The concept_id the user chose (c1, c2 or c3).

name: build_motion

ai_readme.description: AI_README.md for a ready logo animation (get_motion only): the files, which code to use per platform, how to install and paste it, how the animation behaves (pointer reactions for a hero, play once for a launch), reduced motion and checks. Give it to the coding assistant that adds the animation to the user's app or site.

result.description: When ready: live preview link, code per platform, requirements, quality check and 10-minute download links.

title: Build a logo animation concept
